summary.text: You can submit more changes while your current request is in the 12-hour cooling period.

steps.name: Submit further changes
steps.text: Use the Account settings page with your Singpass to submit further changes to your contact details. Your most recent request will replace your previous submission, and the changes take effect after the 12-hour cooling period.
